warden_mira.name: Warden Mira
warden_mira.role: Keeper of the training arena who briefs visitors, watches the pit drills, and holds the cellar key.

cold_start.summary: The party arrives at the Capture Arena gate with no prior context. Present the yard, the goblin noise from the pit, and Warden Mira at the alcove.

partial_context.summary: The party returns to the Capture Arena with partial context. Reuse the known warden and pit details before introducing any new scene.

late_arc.summary: The party reaches the Capture Arena in a late-arc state. Keep the arena compact and let the facilitator steer the scene order.

standalone_fallback.notes: Capture Arena is standalone test tooling and never requires another module.
